text: Floashebel was an early knight of Neverwinter and the third of the Nine knights who served Lord Halueth Never. They were the basis for the Neverwinter Nine.
Fong Moo was an infamous cutpurse from the cities of Baldur's Gate and Athkatla in the 14 century DR.
Flydian was a messenger who resided in the town of Trademeet of Amn in the late 14 century DR.
Gish For'reth was a githyanki warrior who served under Kith'rak Voss as of the late 15 century DR.
Floryn Spellshatter was an adventurer in Cormyr with the Magebanes company in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Forold was a Purple Dragon Knight, part of Azoun IV's retinue in the mid-14 century DR.
Florenta the Garrotter, or simply Flo, was a servant of Zariel and an old friend of hero Karlach Cliffgate, during her time in the Nine Hells in the late 15 century DR.
Fonlim was a gnome wizard who lived in Neverwinter during the late 14 century DR.

Flux slaads were an uncommon variety of slaadi that emerged in the Elemental Chaos following the Spellplague. They were generally smaller and weaker than other varieties of slaadi, garnering them little respect among their peers.
Flo Minsydel was an inhabitant of Baldur's Gate's Lower City in the late 15 century DR.
Flymber Bubbins was an aspiring acolyte of the Open Hand Temple of Ilmater located in the city of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Flynn Silver was a convicted murderer from the city of Baldur's Gate, who lived some years before the late 15 century DR.
Follgast was an elven agent of the Zhentarim in the city of Baldur's Gate in the 15 century DR.
Flue was a Netherese shipwright who helped oversee Gallery Steamers in Eileanar until its destruction in .
Florean Bixworth, husband of Drongo Bixworth, was an inhabitant of the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in late 15 century DR.
Forest hags were a subspecies of green hags that inhabited the the King's Forest of Cormyr.
Foharell was a sea captain and a worshiper of Umberlee who prayed at the Water Queen's House in Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Flo Hapgood was a relative of Grindo Biggs, a Gondian foundry worker who lived in the city of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Forton Lampwicke was a human resident of Eveningstar in Cormyr during the mid-1480s DR.
Fluemartina B. Martelles was a duergar from the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Fortu was a guard in Freedale during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Flower was a pony from Glenraugh in the fey realm of Sarifal in the Moonshae Isles during the mid-to-late 15 century DR.
Fomoyn the Swift was a male wood elf rogue and ranger of the village of Reitheillaethor in the High Forest.
Fyodor was a berserker from Rashemen in the mid–14 century DR. He was a companion and lover to Liriel Baenre. He was a member of the Black Bear lodge fang in Dernovia.
Fredegar Rockcrusher, also known as Fret, was a dwarf sage under the charge of Alustriel in Silverymoon. He was a trusted advisor to both Alustriel and her sister Dove Falconhand.
The Fox-at-Twilight, born Ilira, was a moon elf adventurer and con artist. Known as Light by her friends, she was a rather enigmatic figure at best.
Gacholoths were a type of yugoloth. They served as the infiltrators and terrorists of the Blood War, causing havoc and spreading panic to all sides.
Furo was the Padhrasattva of Knowledge within the Padhran religion. He was the patron god of the Red Mountain Sect and the Red Mountain Temple of Khazari. He was known as Furo the Mighty.
Fulgath was a male human merchant from Dagger Falls that owned Fulgath's Caravan Supplies. He was well known for both his high prices and wide range of equipment.
Frennedan was a doppelganger imprisoned within Jon Irenicus's dungeon underneath the city of Athkatla in 1369 DR.
Frulam Mondath was a member of the reformed Cult of the Dragon of Severin Silrajin, holding the rank of Wearer of the Purple.
Franko Olbert was a man from Nesme in the late 15th century DR.
Fydor was a fire giant and a lieutenant of Queen Hledh Hellspawn, who ruled the city of Maerimydra in the Deep Wastes in the late 15 century DR.
Fukada Shiro was a samurai lord and ally of the Hiro clan in Kozakura in 1357 DR.
Fuantze Wah was a yakuza participant at the Komite in Shou Lung.
Fulbar Hardcheese was a strongheart halfling tavern owner in Daggerford around 1370 DR.
Gabulla was a goblin shaman living near Julkoun around 1485 DR.
Froghemoths were massive amphibious predators with four tentacles and three eyes. They were revered by bullywugs, who treated them as gods.
Foxilon Cardluck, better known as Foxy, was a crew-member of the Halruaan caravel Realms Master in 1370 DR.
Furifax was the most powerful bandit leader in Unther in 1357 DR and in 1375 DR.
Gabrielle was a wizard-in-training of Bloodstone Village in 1357 DR.
Fredegast was the young sheriff of the halfling town of Waukeshire in Bloodstone Barony in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Furier was a renowned mathematician during the 14 century DR. Furier tutored the mathematician Bezier, who was working in Waterdeep by the 14 century DR.
Frizzt Boz'Wevial was a drow wizard and a distant relative of the adventurer Drizzt Do'Urden.
Francan Fireblade was an elder councilor of the Dale Council in High Dale in the late 14 century DR.
Gaal was the high priest of the Cult of the Eyeless, who was zealous in his worship of the Unseeing Eye around 1369 DR.
Frostsilver's Rage was one of many specters trapped in the Frostsilver Mines in the late 15 century DR.
Froal was the first ambassador of Neverwinter circa 1358 DR.

Gabourey D'Vaelan was a cook who lived in Baldur's Gate during the late 15 century DR. She worked for the Vanthampur patriar family at their estate in the city's Temples District circa 1494 DR. Gabourey was rather fastidious and could not abide anyone in her kitchen while she prepared meals.
Frey Silverblade was the leader of the 3 company of High Guards of Waterdeep during the mid–14 century DR.
Frefford Wyvernspur was the child of Wohl Wyvernspur and Lamala Winter who married Gaylyn Dimswart in 1357 DR.
Fuladayah bint Bulad was the daughter of the famed weaponsmith Bulad the Steelmaker. She inhabited Hiyal around 1367 DR.
Captain Frederick was the loyal guard captain leader of Daggerford circa 1372 DR.
Fui D'hang was a general of the Shou Lung empire stationed at the Ginger Palace embassy on the Dragon Coast region of Faerûn during the mid–14 century DR.
Lord Francis Tenraw was a nobleman in a leadership role who lived before 1372 DR.
Fremin Greer was a scholar of questionable ethics specializing in fiendish lore that lived in Baldur's Gate during the late 15 century DR.
Fuorn the Treant-King was an old and magnificent treant that ruled and watched over the Forgotten Forest circa the late 14 century DR.
Othlor Fydra Night-Tree was a Rashemaar Wychlaran inhabiting Immilmar in Rashemen in the .
Fyldrin, who was also called Fyldrin of the Eleven Chairs, was a Rashemaar berserker inhabiting the town of Mulsantir in Rashemen during the late 14 century DR.
Gadalult Mitheir, referred to by some with the nickname Old Leatherjaws, was a priest of Gond who tended to the religious community in Yeshpek in the late 14 century DR.
A fungal hulk or fungus hulk was a monster made of rocks and fungal mass.
Fukio was a legendary ninja who was active in Shou Lung sometime before the 14 century DR.
Frederique, who was also simply called Red for his hair color, was an agent of the Harpers active within the city of Kzelter in the Lake of Steam during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Fyroth Tahsravil was an advisor to Maurandyr who was the High Ward of the fortress town of Hluthvar during the mid-14 century DR.
Frrahr was a gnoll tavern owner inhabiting the city of Zhentil Keep during the mid–14 century DR.
Fusamu was a spinning spider katanga who served the Mother of a Thousand Young within the Fire Mountain of the Malatran Plateau in the late 14 century DR.
Frinli Hinkille was a quick and confident hin cook of the Yawning Portal in the late 14 century DR.
Frenzix was a doppelganger active in Waterdeep in the late 15 century DR.
Frenchy was a traveling bard and entertainer from the Dragon Reach in the The Vast, active in the late 14 century DR.
Gaagash was an orc bloodrager of the Many-Arrows Kingdom, active in the 15 century DR.
Frethian was a black cat inhabiting the city of Waterdeep as of the .
Frestin Cohlver was a young minor aristocrat from Waterdeep as of the late 15 century DR.
Furnbottom Jansen was an aging adventurer from the vast Jansen gnome family, who lived sometime in the early-to-mid–14 century DR.
Sir Ftucis was the Training Master of the Roadwarden Guard, stationed in the Skull Crag Keep in the Storm Horn Mountains of Cormyr in the 14 century DR.
Frezaail was an old male dragon who dwelled in the vicinity of Ironspur in the Galena Mountains circa 1351 DR.
Fovem was a thief and a seller of black market goods from the city of Athkatla in Amn in the late 14 century DR.
Frenya Marshborn was an archer from the village of West Harbor in the Mere of Dead Men circa 1374 DR.
Fris was a city guard of Yhaunn in Sembia during the 14 century DR.
Fraea was a Scornubian woman in the 14 century DR who was strongly implied to be a coinlass.
Frub was a kobold from the Dragon's Rest cloister in the late 15 century DR.
Sir Fuzzalump was an overly serious rock gnome wizard who lived and died in the Western Heartlands during the late 15 century DR.
Froya Harmoot was a Reghedmen human and the mistress of King Jarund Elkhardt from the Tribe of the Elk in the late 15 century DR.
Fridrik Hhune was a member of the Hhune family of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Franc Peartree was a weapons dealer who worked for Lord Enver Gortash of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Queen Fritha Craegmar was the chieftain of the Reghedmen Tribe of the Tiger barbarians during the late 15 century DR.
Fruug, was a servant of Zariel who served her alongside Florenta and her flame, the tiefling named Karlach, during her time in the Nine Hells in the late 15 century DR.
Raider G'r'ath was one of the githyanki who guarded Crèche Y'llek's the hatchery on Toril in the late 15 century DR.
Franchvail was a Netherese cleric of Amaunator who worked at Benante's Butchery in Karsus Enclave until its destruction in .
Fredrichk was a Sentry in the hidden Cloister of Sombre Embrace in the city of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Fuschia Vineshoot was an inhabitant of Baldur's Gate's Lower City in the late 15 century DR.
Gabe was a commoner son of Emmet from the Rivington district of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Fries was a powerful Netherese priest who taught at the Alchemical Seminary in Eileanar in Netheril shortly before its destruction in .
Fukuda Sueji was a samurai retainer of the Hori clan and also a jito in Kozakura in 1357 DR.
Fyrd Nuugh was a criminal who worked against the infamous Guild in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Furbleston was one of the employees of Lady Jannath's Estate in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Frell Olsin was a member of the Gondian clergy and a foundry worker from the city of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Frolo Sledge was a dwarven boat operator in Cormyr during the late 15 century DR.
Fruward the Nail was an infamous and mysterious member of the Guild from the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Frait the Ardent was an elf favored soul in the late 14 century DR.

Comte Franklin duStein was a political figure from the nation of Graubünden in the Whamite Isles. Franklin represented Graubünden in a series of wild conflicts between various nations and pirates of the Whamite Isles at some point prior to the mass death of the population in the .

Queen Francis XII was the queen of Graubünden in the Whamite Isles. Francis represented Graubünden in a series of wild conflicts between various nations and pirates of the Whamite Isles at some point prior to the mass death of the population in the .

Furjur, commonly known as Furjur the Flippant, was a famous merchant from Waterdeep who owned a shop called Furjur's Flying Carpet on Northwind Street in the city of Sundabar in the mid-to-late 14 century DR. Despite owning a shop in the Silver Marches, he was an absentee owner. Furjur's Flying Carpet was instead tended by six female shop-keeps. Around the Year of the Morningstar, 1350 DR, Furjur gifted Nchaser's Eiyromancia to Lord Nasher Alagondar in exchange for a charter. The spellbook was sold to him by a band of adventuring dwarves in the depths of the northern forests.
Freygar Plumbline was a dwarven member of Hal Stoutheart's Tethyamar expedition during the 1480s DR.
Fulgrim Bonebreaker was a durgar thug member of the Night Masks who extorted new arrivals to the city of Westgate in the late 14 century DR.
Francis the All-Seeing was an adventurer from the city of Neverwinter, active in the mid-14 century DR.
Freda Gambosi was a human performer and Harper agent who worked in Eveningstar in Cormyr in the late 15 century DR.
Froedegra was the daughter of a local blacksmith of Halfknot in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Furnis was a gnome from Ieirithymbul in the late 14 century DR.
Froga Gromman was an elder gnome of Ieirithymbul in the late 14 century DR.
Futgar Martovingian was a blacksmith from the city of Liara in Nova Vaasa, one of the Domains of Dread.
Frank DeWilson was a sea captain inhabiting Ravens Bluff in the Vast during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Furten was a halfling Vistani guard of a merchant caravan led by Katriana that visited such towns of Luruar as Hilltop in the late 14 century DR.
Fytz the Firecracker was a weapons trader from the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in late 15 century DR.

Fumble-foot was a hobgoblin in the Lostafinga tribe, who served under Lieutenant Julla, in the mid-to-late 14 century DR. Fumble-foot wasn't his true name, but rather a nickname he had received as a veteran of the troop from sergeants Cheff and Smut, derived from him being clumsy.
Antonella Jusu is a multiplayer character featured in Battlefield 6.
Constantin "Angel" Anghel is a Codex featured in Battlefield 2042.
Col. Hamasaki Nayomi is a Codex featured in Battlefield 2042.
Cmdr. Francisco Santos Batista is a Codex featured in Battlefield 2042.
Craig Brodie is a multiplayer character featured in Battlefield 6.
Idris Omran is a multiplayer character featured in Battlefield 6.
Kimble "Irish" Graves is a Codex featured in Battlefield 2042.
Loyiso "Oz" Okusanya is a Codex featured in Battlefield 2042.
Laila Filai is a multiplayer character featured in Battlefield 6.
Nicole Dumont is a multiplayer character featured in Battlefield 6.
Rebekka Jensen is a multiplayer character featured in Battlefield 6.
Santiago "Dozer" Espinoza is a Codex featured in Battlefield 2042.
"Stretch" Roger was a B-24 bombardier who served during World War II. He was the brother of Roland Roger. He only appeared in the level "Liberators".

Brigadier General "Godfather" Castle is a character and deuteragonist in Call of Duty: Ghosts Extinction mode. He is the commander of CIF Team 1, a squad of the Rapid Reaction Force and one of the main protagonists of the Extinction saga. He is heard in Intel and in cutscenes in Nightfall, Mayday, Awakening and Exodus.

General McDonnell, also known as "Kingpin", is a major character who appears in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. Appearing in multiple trailers for Advanced Warfare, he and Jonathan Irons appear to be discussing a plan for military action on foreign soil, with Irons asking for permission for the operation, to which McDonnell denies. After further arguments, Irons eventually gives up and leaves the General. He isn't heard again until "Sentinel", where it is revealed he is part of the Sentinel Task Force. His last physical appearance is in "Throttle", where he tells Gideon, Mitchell and Cormack the plan to attack New Baghdad, Iraq.

"Smokey" is one of the four Marines that are playable in the Zombies map Verrückt in Call of Duty: World at War. He and his squadmates were part of the mission to rescue Peter McCain which failed, leading to two of the four soldiers dying, one escaping, and one being captured and brainwashed. He is mentioned in two of John "Banana"'s limericks found by Oppenheimer, the first one acknowledging his death as he tries to kill John and continues trying even after being decapitated, showing he had been turned into a zombie. Smokey is mentioned once more in the map Revelations in John's radio message hidden in the Verrückt section of the map.
"Bluey" Smith is a character featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard.
Aaron I. Jordaniels, better known as A.J., is a playable character featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare's Zombies. He is voiced by Ike Barinholtz.

Private Aleksandr Sokolov (Russian: Александр Соколов) was a Soviet soldier in the Red Army during World War II. Aleksandr Sokolov was first shown in the game Call of Duty: Finest Hour as the first playable character in the Russian campaign.

Alexei Ivanovich Voronin (Russian: Алексей Иванович Воронин) is the playable Russian soldier in Call of Duty's Russian Campaign, and one of the three playable characters in the game. He was conscripted into the 13th Guards Rifle Division and served under the command of Major Zubov, where he goes on to fight in many battles across the Eastern Front.
Private Anderson is a character featured in Call of Duty: United Offensive. He was an American paratrooper who served with the 506th Parachute Infantry Regiment during World War II.

Private Allen Rowe is a British soldier appearing in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. During World War II, Rowe served with Popski's Private Army and with them participated in numerous raids on German targets in Tunisia.
Private Amick is a soldier that fights with Able Company, who appears in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. He is seen only in the campaign mission "Last Bridge Standing".
Private Alderman is an American soldier who appears in Call of Duty 2.

Sergeant Alex McCall was a playable character of the US 4th Armored Division in Call of Duty: World at War: Final Fronts. After linking up with the 80th Infantry Division at Ettelbruck, Luxembourg, McCall's tank squadron spearheaded the assault to break the German siege of Bastogne during the Battle of the Bulge. As the gunner of an M4 Sherman tank, McCall destroyed numerous German Panzer IV tanks and one Tiger I tank. He also supported the infantry against enemy defenses during the assault. The 4th Armored later reached Bastogne after Private Tom Sharpe's squad of the 6th Airborne Division had already wreaked havoc on the German defenses. de:Alex McCall
Corporal Alan Bradshaw is a First Canadian Army operative who appears in Call of Duty: Roads to Victory.

Alberto Vazquez is a character featured in Call of Duty Online. A powerful organized crime figure operating in the Juarito region, Vazquez holds the rank of General and maintains connections within both the government and criminal organizations. He is allied with the Cortez cartel, which he supplies with military-grade weapons, and serves as an antagonist during the early missions of the campaign.

Sergeant Alex V. Johnson (codenamed Ajax) was a special forces soldier and Ghosts member and former United States Marine that appears in the Call of Duty: Ghosts missions Struck Down and Legends Never Die.

Alex Dubois is a character in Call of Duty: Strike Team. He serves as the regional training director for the Tacitus Corporation and he assists the JSOC in tracking down Felix Kaplan in the Afghanistan campaign.
Captain Ajani is a character in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare.
The Advisor is a character in Call of Duty: Heroes. He is present in the tutorial level, and gives the player tips about what to do.
Andrea is a character featured in Call of Duty Online and one of three default characters that are initially unlocked, alongside Yuri and Beast.
Alex, also known as the Bounty Hunter, is a character featured in Call of Duty Online.

Corporal Al Martin is a character in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. He appears in the level Come Out Fighting, helping set up the artillery for the attack on Tillet after Rivers' division clears the area.
Andre J. Wright is a playable character featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare Zombies. He is voiced by Jay Pharoah.
Private Allan is a character featured in Call of Duty 2. He served in the 7th Armoured Division under the command of Captain Price, seeing action in North Africa.
American Bulldog is a playable character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile. He was released during Season 9: Conquest as part of the Manifest Destiny Draw.
Agent Miller is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile Comics, introduced in the Season 3: Radical Raid.
Alpha One is a character featured in Call of Duty: Strike Team. He is a part of the four man team sent to Arctic Circles in order to exfiltrate the missile silo.

Alexis Cabrera ( Kaufman), better known as , is an American . Bliss is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was released on October 2nd, 2025 during Season 9: Midnight Rumble as part of the Alexa Bliss Draw.

Sergeant Sergei Antonov (Russian: Сергей Антонов) is a Soviet Commissar in the game Call of Duty: United Offensive. He first appears in the first Russian campaign level after the player comes out of the ammunition bunker. He is the player's squad leader in each Russian mission with the exception of tank levels. In the first level, he will act like a Commissar and shoot the player if they fall back in the trenches, as will the other Commissar in the same trench. In the second level, he orders the player to spot targets for Miesha Korolov so they could take out machine gun nests and Elefant tanks. He is reassigned with the rest of his squad to the 15th Guards Rifle Division after Yuri Petrenko
Angus was a British airman in the RAF, assigned to the No. 90 Bomber Squadron with the B-17 "A for Andy." He appears in the first British campaign mission Bomber in Call of Duty: United Offensive.
Sergeant Anna Posadskaya (Russian: Анна Посадская) is a female Red Army soldier who fought in the Battle of Stalingrad during World War II, as seen in Call of Duty: Finest Hour.
Sergeant Andrews is a British S.F.S.G. and playable character who appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3: Defiance.
Anvil is a United States Air Force member featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3: Defiance. Anvil assists the SFSG ground team in the level Overwatch by bombing Russian tanks.

Senior Lieutenant Attila Zalanyi is a minor antagonist in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. He is a member of the Settlement Defense Front and commander of the destroyer SDS Iani Chaos. Zalanyi was killed in the explosion of his destroyer.

Lieutenant Commander Audrey "Mac" MaCallum is a character featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. She was the Chief Engineer of the Retribution. She was once the captain of her own ship, but resigned her commission after finding she was unable to cope with the responsibility of willingly sacrificing her subordinates, even for the sake of victory.

Major Auguste is a character featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. He is a SATO officer stationed in Geneva, Switzerland. While leading the prisoner escort of Akeel Min Riah, his convoy was ambushed, injuring him in the process.

Junior Lieutenant Andrew Hawryluk is a minor antagonist in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare and member of the Settlement Defense Front. He's assigned to the SetDef Destroyer SDS Icarius. He was killed during Operation Deep Execute by Nick Reyes while Reyes was fleeing the Icarius.
Arthur McIntosh, also known as the Rat King, is a character and the main boss in the Zombies map Shaolin Shuffle in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare .
Major Arthur Crowley is a character that appears in Call of Duty: WWII as a part of the British Special Operations Executive.

Anna Muller is a minor character in Call of Duty: WWII. She is one of the German citizens who take shelter in the Allendorf hotel basement during the U.S armed forces invasion of the Germany city of Aachen.

Sergeant Anjos is a minor character in Call of Duty: WWII. He is one of the heroic action events during the Battle of the Bulge mission. He is seen struggling with a German soldier. Ronald "Red" Daniels can choose to save him or not.

Lieutenant Asim Omari (Arabic: عاصم عمری), better known as the Slayer, is a character within Call of Duty: WWII Nazi Zombies and member of the Bureau of Archaic Technologies. It is also noticed that Asim is dressed in polish uniform, including the famous polish cap "Rogatywka".

Anna Buckler, also known as Artery is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on May 22nd, 2020, during Season 6 Once Upon A Time In Rust as part of The Huntress Draw. Later, during Season 7: Elite of Elite, Artery appears in the Comics, being part of a mysterious organization called The Dark Covenant.

Anna Drake is an Operator of the Yeti faction featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard and Call of Duty: Warzone. Anna was released with Season Two as part of the Battle Pass. Anna appears in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added on January 16th, 2025 as part of the Season 1: Wings of Vengeance Battle Pass.
Anya, also known as Daywalker, is a character featured in Call of Duty Online.
Seaman Second Class Barron was a member of the United States Navy who appears in Call of Duty: World at War.
Colonel Ayala was a minor character in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare: Mobilized. He was a well known weapons supplier in South-America and had supplied a nuclear device to Prince Farhad.
Bastien is a character in V.E.R.S.I.O.N.. He lives in , Switzerland and is 26 years old.

Oberst Baumann is a character in Call of Duty: WWII. He is an officer wearing grey uniform in the garrison. The player assumes control of Camille "Rousseau" Denis and can interact with him, asking him where Karl Fischer and the basement is, or telling him the code phrase "Verlaine". If the player tells him the code phrase, he will ask Rousseau to give him the ID papers and ask her where she was from initially. If she responds "Berlin" instead of "Hamburg", she will be arrested, and the player will see a game over screen. He is later killed by the French Resistance when they entered the garrison after Rousseau blow up the entrances.

Beatrice Mercier (French: Béatrice Mercier) is an Operator of the Barbarian faction featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard and Call of Duty: Warzone. Beatrice appears in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added on November 9th, 2023, as part of the Season 10: 4th Anniversary Battle Pass.

Batou Buttetsu is a character from the Ghost in the Shell franchise featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on August 9th, 2022, during Season 7: New Vision City as part of the Tachikomatic Draw.
Sergeant William "Bill" Taylor was an American soldier who fought in World War II. Taylor is the main protagonist of the Call of Duty 2 American Campaign.
Colonel Blake, callsign Baker Six was an American soldier who was in charge of the 2nd Ranger Battalion, as seen in Call of Duty 2.
Sergeant Bob Starkey is a commando in Popski's Private Army, a British special forces unit, who fought during World War II, as seen during the events of Call of Duty: Finest Hour.
Black Lily, also known as Athena, is a character featured in Call of Duty Online.
Biochemical Madman is a character featured in Call of Duty Online.

[https://www.youtube.com/BobbyPlays BobbyPlays] is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on January 13th, 2022, during Season 11: Final Snow as part of the BobbyPlays Bundle. BobbyPlays is an American Call of Duty: Mobile player and content creator with over 980,000 subscribers on YouTube as of 2025.
Lieutenant Bobby was an American officer who served with the 506th Parachute Infantry Regiment during World War II as featured in Call of Duty: United Offensive.

Blix is a character featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. He is a South Korean mercenary working for the Korean People's Army. Blix is also featured as an Operator in Modern Warfare 4 and Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0.
Blackwell is an Operator featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 and Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0.
Private Braeburn, callsign Dog Five, was an American soldier who fought during World War II, as seen in the events of Call of Duty 2.

Corporal Bohater Wojciech is a soldier in the Polish 1st Armored Division and one of the playable characters of Call of Duty 3. He takes part in the assault on the Falaise Gap and helps his fellow soldiers defend Hill 262.
Captain Burwell was a British soldier who appears in Call of Duty 2.
Sergeant Borodin (Russian: Бородин) served in the Soviet Red Army as a Sergeant during the Battle of Stalingrad.
Boris Semashko (Russian: Борис Семашко) was a private in Call of Duty: United Offensive who fights during World War II with the player and his squad. He fights in the Battle of Kursk.
Private Bueller was a member of the 29th Infantry Division who fought in Saint-Lô, as seen in the events of Call of Duty 3.
Private First Class C. Miller is a United States Marine that served in World War II in the Pacific theater. He is one of the three playable characters in the Call of Duty: World at War campaign.
Private Butler is an American paratrooper that appeared in Call of Duty: Big Red One during the campaign mission "Operation Husky".
Yeoman First Class Bowen was a member of the U.S. Navy who appeared in Call of Duty: World at War.
Private Bricker is a 1st Infantry Division soldier that appeared in Call of Duty: Finest Hour.
Private Brian L. Preston is a playable British character in Call of Duty: Roads to Victory.
Private Bower was an American soldier that fought in the 90th Infantry Division as seen in Call of Duty 3.

Colonel Brandon Cornelius Stafford was a character featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops Mobile. He was William James Bennett's superior and the unit's commander. Stafford was killed during the level , Crash.
Borland is a minor character featured in the mission Severed Ties in Call of Duty: Ghosts.
The C8 is an android that appears in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. It also appears in multiplayer a scorestreak, known as the R-C8.

Captain Bradley Fillion is the tertiary antagonist in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. He was a member of the Settlement Defense Front and defector of the United Nations Space Alliance. He was the commander of the SetDef carrier SDS Ares Vallis. He is ultimately killed by Nick Reyes during an assault on the Ares Vallis by SATO following the SDF attack on The Gateway Port located on Luna.

Chief Corpsman Bryant Ling is a character featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. He is a corpsman stationed aboard the UNSA Tigris. He appears solely in the epilogue of the mission Operation Burn Water, where he helps revive Captain Nick Reyes after he runs out of oxygen in the orbit of Titan. He is presumed to have been killed along with everyone else aboard the Tigris following the Olympus Mons surprise attack on the ship.

Brozek is a Navy SCAR and Jackal pilot briefly featured in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. She assists Reyes, Ethan, and Salter in destroying the SDF refueling station on Titan. However, upon exfiltrating Titan's atmosphere, she and the rest of the SCAR team are ambushed by the Olympus Mons, and she is subsequently shot down.

Private Briggs is a minor character in Call of Duty: WWII. His name is mentioned by Daniels. He and other soldiers flee the German artillery in Death Factory. After the artillery barrage, Daniels is horrified to see his dead body and takes his M1911 to sneak through the Dragon's Teeth.
Boris Petrov is a character featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard. He is the father of Polina Petrova and Misha Petrov.
Private Boris Rubinski (Russian: Борис Рубинский) is a character in Call of Duty: Finest Hour. He is a Red Army soldier who fought in the Battle of Stalingrad in World War II.
The CIA Operative is a character featured in Call of Duty: Black Ops: Declassified. He was assigned to eliminate key drug cartel leaders, Torres and Jose Luiz Menendez.

Vice Admiral Caleb Thies is a minor antagonist in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. He is a member of the Settlement Defense Front, commander of the Icarius and co-conspirator of the Geneva attack with Salen Kotch.

Private Carson is a U.S. Marine during World War II. He is seen in the Call of Duty: World at War: Final Fronts level "Typhoon of Steel", as the marine holding a flamethrower burning the Japanese bunker.
Sergeant Carver is a character featured in Call of Duty 2. He served in the 7th Armoured Division under the command of Captain Price, seeing action in North Africa.

Private Camilleri is a character who appears in Call of Duty: World at War (Nintendo DS). Despite holding the rank of private, he gives orders to Rook for part of the mission "Beach Landing". Camilleri is later killed during a Japanese ambush when the team approaches the airstrip.
Private Caratelli is a character in Call of Duty: WWII. While clearing trenches during D-Day, he is ambushed by a German soldier. Ronald "Red" Daniels can choose to intervene to save him or not.
Private Chernov (Russian: Чернов) was a Red Army soldier in Call of Duty: World at War. He was one of the main characters that followed the player through most of the Soviet campaign.
Private Clements was an American Paratrooper who appeared in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One.
Clark was a soldier of the Canadian Armed Forces, serving with the Calgary Highlanders. He was featured in Call of Duty: Roads to Victory.

Chris Greene, also known as Torch, is a character in Call of Duty: Ghosts. He is a member of the Ghosts and the unit known as STALKER. He is mentioned to have gone missing and possibly been killed near Zones Romeo and Sierra. He seems to have been tortured sometime shortly before or after his disappearance.
The Charger is a type of Zombie that appears in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare in Exo Zombies.

Junior Lieutenant Cesar Magana is an antagonist in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare and a member of the Settlement Defense Front. He's assigned to the SetDef carrier SDS Cerberus. Magana is killed by Nick Reyes during Operation Phoenix.
Lieutenant Chard was an American officer serving in the 82nd Airborne Division who fought in World War 2. He was featured in Call of Duty: Roads to Victory.

Claire Richmond, also known as Alias is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on March 26, 2021, during Season 2: Day of Reckoning as part of Doppelganger Draw. Later, in Season 7: New Vision City, Alias appears in the Comics.

Cecilia Perrin, also known as Dame, is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile, introduced in Season 4: Spurned & Burned Comics and was released as a playable character on July 9, 2021, during Season 5: In Deep Water as part of the Crimson Dame Draw.
Cedric Montpierre also known as Roger Vachon is a character featured in the Call of Duty: Mobile comics.

Private Clinton was an American soldier, who served in the 82nd Airborne Division during World War II. He was featured in Call of Duty: Roads to Victory. He can spawn with either a Thompson or an M1A1 Carbine.
Chen Jin, also known as Lustre, is a character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile. She was added in the game on January 16th, 2025 as part of Season 1: Wings of Vengeance Battle Pass.
Chen Xiaotang is a character featured in Call of Duty Online.

Private First Class Cho Han (Korean: 조한}, also known as Chow, is a character featured in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. He is a South Korean Marine. Cho is also featured as an Operator in Modern Warfare 4 and Call of Duty: Warzone 2.0.
First Lieutenant Coffey is an American officer who fought during World War II with the 2nd Ranger Battalion as seen in Call of Duty 2.
Private Coen is an American medic paratrooper who served with the 506th Parachute Infantry Regiment during World War II as featured in Call of Duty: United Offensive.

Private Colliatie was a Marine that joined the player during a rescue mission in Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare (Nintendo DS). Colliatie accompanied the player through the opening moments of the mission "Hard Impact", where the Marine Evac Team must rescue Hawk One, a helicopter shot down by Al-Asad's militia in the Middle East. Colliatie helped fight past a militia machine gun emplacement. Upon rounding a corner, he alerted the player of an entrance to the emplacement, and told the player to "Take out the emplacement to your left." After the player dispatched the gunner and returned to Colliatie, he was shot and killed by one of the militia soldiers sniping from a balcony.
Private Cooper is a member of the 6th British Airborne Division. He is part of "The Relief of Bastogne" along with Rogers, Maddock, Taylor and Sharpe.

Sergeant Cole is a British S.F.S.G. troop who appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3: Defiance. He assisted in the breaching of Hoover Dam to prevent Russian forces from compromising its interior. They failed and the second generator was destroyed.
Second Lieutenant Collins is a supporting character in Call of Duty: Ghosts for the mission Loki. He is the leader of Icarus.
"Contact 28" is a character in Call of Duty: Ghosts Extinction mode. He is only heard through Intel found in Nightfall. He is a client of David Archer, the leader of the Nightfall Program.

The Commander is a character featured in Call of Duty: Heroes. He may occasionally visit the player's base if they have built the Landing Zone. He will ask the player to escort him to a Deployment Yard, and will reward the player with four Celerium.

Constanze Trude Muller is an Operator of the Sentinel faction featured in Call of Duty: Vanguard and Call of Duty: Warzone. Constanze appears in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added on October 3rd, 2024, as part of the Season 9: Orbital Raiders Ground Forces subscription.

Codename: Lazarus, also known as simply Lazarus, is character featured in Call of Duty: Mobile and was added in the game on November 21st, 2021, during Season 10: Shadows Return as part of the Damned to Life Mythic Drop Draw. Lazarus also appears in the comics
The Cuban Interrogator is a character who appeared in Call of Duty: Black Ops (Nintendo DS).
Code name Cowboy is a US Air Force pilot who appears in Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3: Defiance.

Cyborg Zombie, known as Cyborg or Mechanical Zombie, is an enemy that appears in Call of Duty Online in the game mode Cyborg Rising, Death March, Cyborg Evacuation, and Air Reaper. They are similar to zombies in Zombies mode but are cybernetic with blue blood instead of organic. In Cyborg Rising, the zombies have a more mechanical and cybernetic appearance, with their eye color indicating their threat level. Blue-eyed Mechanical Zombies are the weakest, followed by yellow-eyed and orange-eyed variants, while red-eyed Mechanical Zombies are the most powerful. Later modes feature more human and bio-organic designs, with Cyborg Evacuation featuring infected-human-like models alongside the mutat

Major Cormack is the tritagonist (along with Ilona) in Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare. He was Mitchell's squad leader during his time in the Marines before becoming a leading member of an elite U.S.-led multinational special ops team called the Sentinel Task Force. He is a kind and good-hearted man with a strong sense of honor and duty as he cares greatly for his men. He is the announcer for the Sentinel Task Force in multiplayer.
Admiral Coupe is a character in Call of Duty: Infinite Warfare. She became the head of the SATO Fleet after the death of Fredrick Raines.
The Corpse Eater is a special zombie, appearing in the Call of Duty: WWII Nazi Zombies map The Frozen Dawn.

D'Angelo is a member of the Fox Company as part of the 101st Airborne Division. He fights alongside Scott Riley and Captain Foley during the Battle of Foy. He is killed by an incoming mortar round when running for cover.
Lieutenant David Coen is an American soldier of the 1st Infantry Division that appears in Call of Duty: Finest Hour.
Private Dean was a rifleman of Fox Company who fought in the "Battle of Piano Lupo", as seen in the events of Call of Duty 2: Big Red One.

Private Dawkins was a soldier in Fox Company of the 1st Infantry Division in World War II. He is seen in Call of Duty 2: Big Red One. Dawkins fights alongside Pvt. Roger while defending Kasserine Pass.
Captain David Vance is an experienced aviator and minor playable character in Call of Duty: Black Ops (Nintendo DS).
Private Davies was a British Paratrooper in the 6th Airborne Division. He was a part of Sergeant Maddock's Squad. He appears in "The Relief of Bastogne".
Private David Ferguson is a playable character who appears in the level Scavenger Hunt in Call of Duty: Road to Victory.
